content.comment_body: Hello, Within [product_name], I have implemented a clock element and selected an IoT Device, but I am not receiving any data from it. Can anyone point out what I might be missing?
Hello, With such a broad question, it's difficult to provide a specific solution. Please consider uploading your program for review.

The program is confidential. Using [product_name], displaying the clock from a local device (project saved on SD-card) has worked reliably for a while. Since update [version_no], the feature to show the clock from an IoT device was added. When I upload my [product_name] project to AWS, the clock element does not receive any data from the IoT device. Should something be enabled in "Cloud data transfer settings" or am I missing another step?
Hello, Were you able to find a workaround for this problem?

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered a problem where the clock element in [product_name] is not receiving data from an IoT device after the project is transferred to AWS. Previously, displaying the clock using a local device worked without issues. The issue arose following a recent update that added new cloud functionality, suggesting there may be gaps in configuration clarity or workflow guidance related to cloud data transfer settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes the clock element in [product_name] will receive data from an IoT device on AWS just as it does with a local device. They expect a smooth and effortless experience when using new cloud-based features, with straightforward instructions for any required configuration changes.
